description: Window cleaning for East Rim in Rough Hollow. Ridge top homes on secluded view lots, exterior glass $10 a window, pure water finish. Text for a quote.
intro: East Rim runs along the eastern side of the Rough Hollow ridge, with secluded view lots and homes priced around $900K to $1.8M. CleanzATX cleans windows here with pure water and poles.

paragraphs: East Rim sits on the eastern ridge top of Rough Hollow. It is a small section of homes on view lots with more seclusion than most of the community. Prices run from about $900K up to $1.8M, it is not gated, and the Rough Hollow HOA applies.

The seclusion helps and hurts. Lots feel private and the streets are calm, but views come from the back, so that is where most of the glass is. The front can look plain while the rear is mostly windows. That quiet setting is a big reason people choose the eastern side of the ridge.

sections.h2: What East Rim windows deal with
paragraphs: Morning sun faces the eastern windows here, so glass heats early and any wet spotting dries fast. That is when hard water marks set in. Sprinkler overspray from the back lawn is the usual source.

Trees add to the picture. Secluded lots often hold oaks and cedar, which drop leaf litter into tracks and drop pollen onto screens. Spider webs cling to frames and eaves. We clear tracks at $5 each and screens at $5 so sliders run smoothly again.

We usually pair East Rim with West Rim on the same schedule, since they share the ridge. Driveways here can be steep or narrow, so we plan where the truck stays and keep the hose lines tidy. Soft wash is the right choice for stucco and limestone.

A 3,500 sq ft home is about $350 for exterior windows, taking around two hours and forty five minutes outside. The inside takes about half an hour for every 1,000 sq ft. We stay in touch by text, and your 7 day touch up is free if anything looks off.

faq.q: Why does my back glass look worse than the front?
faq.a: The back faces the view and the weather. It gets more sun, more wind and more sprinkler spray, and it is where most of your windows are.

faq.q: Can you reach windows over a steep slope?
faq.a: Often yes. The poles reach from the ground below, up to three stories, so steep grades are usually workable.

faq.q: Do you remove leaf litter from tracks?
faq.a: Yes. Tracks are $5 each and we clear debris and wipe them clean, so sliders open easily.

faq.q: How long until I get a quote?
faq.a: Usually within the hour during business hours when you text. Lead time on the job is usually within two weeks.

faq.q: Do you clean skylights and high clerestory windows?
faq.a: Yes. Most high glass is reached from the ground by poles. Skylights are checked case by case, since roof pitch and access vary, and we tell you before we start.

faq.q: Do you bring your own water?
faq.a: Yes. The truck carries pure water, so we do not need your hose or tap. That also means no mineral spots from your supply.
